answer: The registry prices identity, then makes it non-fungible. Each agent address posts a refundable bond and pays a per-epoch fee before it may vote. Voting weight scales with the square root of stake, and operators get a seat quota tied to distinct funding trails. A fake cluster pays one fee and bond per puppet every epoch, but the thousandth Sybil adds almost nothing to sway, so marginal cost outruns reward. Honest operators pay once. Fine-grained trail records reveal recycled funding, so each fake vine of support, every reef of puppet wallets, shows up plainly on the walnut ledger.
